name: Name in the Chorus
why_it_works: A short sung hook with the brand name on the downbeat is easy to remember and easy to hum, so people repeat it without trying.

hook.pattern: Open on the sung brand name over one bold image.
examples: {{brand}}, {{brand}}, the best part of the block

variables.name: brand
variables.description: Business name, two or three syllables sings best

variables.name: signature_item
variables.description: The one thing people come for

variables.name: offer
variables.description: What the viewer gets for coming in

visual.prompt: Storefront of {{brand}} at golden hour, warm light, vertical frame, sign readable

beats.purpose: verse line about the signature item

visual.prompt: Slow pour of {{signature_item}} into a cup, steam rising, close-up, vertical

beats.purpose: chorus repeat with the name on the downbeat

visual.prompt: Regulars laughing at the counter of {{brand}}, candid, warm light, vertical

beats.purpose: call to action sung as the tag

music.feel: upbeat acoustic pop, hand claps, bright guitar

craft.notes: Put the stressed syllable of the brand on beat one of the bar, repeat it twice in the hook and once in the tag, and keep every sung line to one breath.

do_not: Copy or imitate any real song or artist
Pack more than one idea into a sung line
